### Compass Pathways Celebrates Opening of New U.S. Office in Jersey City, New Jersey


October 5, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s204.q4cdn.com/927483861/files/doc_news/Compass-Pathways-Celebrates-Opening-of-New-U-S--Office-in-Jersey-City-New-Jersey-2026-IF7TAw8tpv-2026.pdf)


Compass Pathways plc (Nasdaq: CMPS), a biotechnology company dedicated to unlocking urgently needed new treatment options in mental health care, today celebrated the opening of its new U.S. office in Jersey City, New Jersey, with a ribbon-cutting ceremony attended by company leaders, employees and local officials.


The new 6,327-square-foot office will serve as a hub for Compass employees across the tri-state area. The space will bring together teams across functions as Compass advances U.S. commercial readiness activities for COMP360, its investigational synthetic psilocybin treatment program for treatment-resistant depression, in anticipation of a potential U.S. launch in the first half of 2027, subject to FDA approval.


Compass selected Jersey City because of its proximity to one of the country's most established life sciences and healthcare ecosystems, access to a strong local talent pool and its growing role as a destination for biotechnology innovation. The company currently has approximately 175 U.S.-based employees, including more than 60 employees across New Jersey, New York and Pennsylvania, with New Jersey representing one of Compass' largest employee populations in the country.


“Today is about more than an office – it is about the Compass colleagues who will fill this space with purpose and the people living with serious mental health conditions who are at the heart of our work,” said Kabir Nath, Chief Executive Officer of Compass Pathways. “I’ve spent a significant part of my career in New Jersey, and I’ve seen firsthand the strength of the life sciences community here. Compass is proud to call Jersey City home as we advance into our next phase of growth and continue working to bring better options to people who are still suffering.”


The opening marks an important milestone as Compass continues advancing COMP360 and its U.S. footprint in support of its next phase of growth.


**About Compass Pathways**


We believe mental health patients deserve the possibility of a better future. Compass Pathways plc (Nasdaq: CMPS) is a biotechnology company dedicated to unlocking urgently needed new treatment options in mental health care. Our initial focus is developing COMP360 psilocybin, a proprietary, investigational, synthetic psilocybin treatment under evaluation for treatment-resistant depression (TRD) and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). COMP360 is a potentially first-in-class treatment and has Breakthrough Therapy designation from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), as well as Innovative Licensing and Access Pathway (ILAP) designation in the UK for TRD. We are leading the world’s largest classic psychedelic clinical program in TRD, and building upon that robust foundation, we are executing a late-stage trial evaluating COMP360 for PTSD, another condition with high unmet need. Our goal is to advance treatments that move the field of psychiatry towards treatment options that offer rapid onset and sustained durability with infrequent dosing.


Compass is headquartered in London, UK, with a U.S. office in New Jersey.


We are driven by our purpose of unlocking pathways to be – opening futures filled with possibility. Together, we are on an ambitious journey toward enabling people living with mental health conditions to find clarity through self-discovery, because every journey needs a Compass.
